aspect: The concept and where it came from
description: Developed in the 1980s by mental health professionals in apartheid-era South Africa, who found PTSD frameworks failed people whose victimisation was ongoing rather than finished.
energy_note: A diagnosis written for a war that ended.
source_name: Straker et al.; APA special issue 2013

aspect: The symptoms are adaptive, which is why treating them fails
description: Avoiding the street during shelling and not sleeping during an air raid are correct responses. Evidence: once a resident leaves the affected area, symptoms subside dramatically - the opposite of a conditioned false alarm.
energy_note: Being told to relax about something that is still happening.
source_name: PTSD under ongoing threat review, PMC4980518

aspect: Its factor structure is different from PTSD
description: The validated Continuous Traumatic Stress Response scale loads on exhaustion/detachment, rage/betrayal and fear/helplessness - not intrusion, avoidance and arousal. Rage and betrayal are the ones clinicians miss.
energy_note: It comes out as fury at your own government, not fear.

description: Consistent with allostatic load: repeated attacks reinforce the belief that the threat will never end, and wellbeing erodes over time. Inadequate response by authorities specifically fosters rage and helplessness.
energy_note: It gets worse with practice, not better.

aspect: No DSM-5 or ICD-11 status, which has practical consequences
description: Because it is a framework rather than a diagnosis, it cannot be claimed for, insured against, or used to obtain accommodations at work or in asylum proceedings.
money_note: Treatment and claims not covered because the condition is not coded.
energy_note: Real, documented, and not on any form.

aspect: SCENARIO - the ceasefire that changed nothing
description: The conditional ceasefire was declared in April. He still does not sleep, because a conditional ceasefire is a description of the present, not a promise about the future, and his body has read the word 'conditional'.
energy_note: Peace, subject to terms, is not peace to a nervous system.
